delta_brief.failure_correction: The first read-only run was auto-denied because it attempted a command not covered by the current central allow rules. Do not retry that command and do not request or infer broader permissions.
delta_brief.allowed_commands: Use only commands whose executable is exactly one of: rg, find, wc, sort, grep. Do not run git, pwd, cd, test, sha256sum, shell built-ins, scripts, interpreters, package managers, or any other executable. Do not use a command merely to verify the worktree; the relay performs the read-only fingerprint independently.
delta_brief.simplified_verification: Complete the original inventory using only the allowed commands. Report the exact commands actually run. The final report must omit any pre/post Git status SHA claim and instead state that worktree mutation verification is relay-owned. Keep every original path, exclusion, no-network, no-write, no-decision, counting, and output constraint unchanged.
